notes: New Giveaway feature (phase 1: Telegram + YouTube): a new public page (giveaway.twig, on the smmplus-website site) lets logged-in users verify they joined the Telegram channel (via the Telegram Login Widget + a bot membership check) or subscribed on YouTube (via Google OAuth) - both checked automatically. New Giveaway > Settings page for the bot username, Google OAuth credentials, and YouTube channel id.
